principle: Relationship state is persistent, directional and multidimensional; every meaningful change requires represented cause and provenance.
rules: Initial friendship, trust, mentorship, hostility or intimacy cannot exist without plausible shared-history provenance.
Co-location alone may create recognition/familiarity but not deep relationship history.
A single positive interaction does not automatically create friendship or strong trust.
A disagreement does not automatically create permanent hostility.
Professional respect, command confidence, personal affinity, trust, fear, affection and intimacy remain separate dimensions.
Relationship edges are directional and may be asymmetric.
Rank or authority can require compliance without creating trust, affection or consent.
Romantic interest may be unilateral; relationship commitment requires compatible reciprocal state.
Consent is event/context specific and is never inferred from rank, prior affection, reputation, gifts or repeated pressure.
Separation, transfer, death or estrangement does not erase shared history.
Off-screen relationship changes require plausible contact, elapsed time and represented interaction/event causes.
AI can express relationship state but cannot directly authoritatively advance it without validated events.
Romantic invitation, acceptance, completed date, relationship commitment and intimacy are separate causal events.
Player romantic/consent state cannot be inferred from compatibility, repeated contact or NPC desire.
Romantic rejection alone is not sufficient cause for hostility, resentment or retaliation.
Project romantic/sexual relationship changes must satisfy the locked adult heterosexual relationship canon.
